scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Hey, there.
Have you ever heard that there
are totally different countries
than the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
嘿，你听说过吗？卢恩·米德加兹王国之外，还有风貌完全不同的国家。

scripts.text: About Amatsu...
scripts.translation: 关于樱花城...

scripts.text: Go to Amatsu
scripts.translation: 前往樱花城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
I heard that a drifting ship
accidentally discovered it...
The ship was totally destroyed
by a raging storm in heavy fog.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
听说，有人乘船漂流时，偶然发现了那里...
他的船在浓雾中遇上猛烈的风暴，被彻底摧毁了。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Anyway, the ship was wrecked
on the beach. It was there
he arrived at a town called Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
总之，船在海滩上失事，他辗转来到一座名叫樱花城的小镇。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
The towners took pity on him
and took care of his wounds.
He lived there until he finished making a map.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
镇民们怜悯他，替他治伤。
他在当地住了一阵，直到画好了地图。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
He passed away when he returned
to Rune-Midgarts. Fortunately,
the map was given to our king, Tristan III.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
他返回卢恩·米德加兹后去世了。
幸好，那张地图交到了国王特里斯坦三世手中。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
King Tristan III announced
that he would reward any
person brave enough to venture to Amatsu, and spread copies of this map.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
特里斯坦三世国王分发了地图的副本，并宣布重赏敢于航行到樱花城的勇者。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Many brave and adventurous
sea captains took the
challenge. Great fortune could
be made in trade with Amatsu, as well as the rewards from King Tristan III...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
许多勇敢、富有冒险精神的船长接受了挑战。
毕竟，与樱花城通商能赚大钱，还能得到国王的赏赐...

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
However, they all failed!
To overcome various currents
and bad weather, lots of
experience is required. But they were all blinded by their greed...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
可他们全都失败了！
要应对各种洋流和恶劣天气，需要丰富的经验，他们却被贪念蒙蔽了双眼...

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Finally, a great man discovered
the perfect sealane to Amatsu...
Right! That is me. Sir Walter
Moers. I started the trade with Amatsu! Hahaha! Well, that's all about Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
最后，一位伟人找到了通往樱花城的最佳航线...
没错，就是我，瓦尔特·默斯爵士！我开创了与樱花城的贸易！哈哈哈！
好啦，樱花城的故事就讲到这里。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
I made good money from trades
for years, and now I'm interested
in tourism. If you want to go to Amatsu, let me know~!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
这些年，贸易让我赚了不少钱，现在我又对旅游业感兴趣了。
想去樱花城，就告诉我~！

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Oh yeah? It's a long way to
Amatsu. That's why we are
charging a fare. You don't think that crossing oceans and currents is easy, do you?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
哦，想去？樱花城可远着呢，所以要收船费。
你不会以为横渡大洋、穿越洋流很容易吧？

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
10,000 zeny for a round-trip! I've
got a stately room in a sturdy and
safe trade ship for you. It is a 
reasonable fare when you consider
that this isn't a one way trip.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
往返只要10,000 Zeny！
船是坚固安全的商船，还给你安排了豪华客房。
这可不是单程票，船费很合理吧？

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Shall we go now? You didn't forget
the fare, right? Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
我们现在出发吗？
你没忘船费吧？
走吧。

scripts.text: All Aboard!
scripts.translation: 全体登船！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Alright, I will start the engine!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
好的，我要启动引擎了！

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Were you even listening to me?
10,000 zeny. If you got
nothing, find some treasure
somewhere, like in a wrecked ship...Show me the money!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
你到底有没有听我说话？船费10,000 Zeny。
没钱就去找点宝藏，比如到沉船里找找...
先把钱拿来！

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
If you are an adventurer,
this is a great chance
to experience a different culture...Well, it is up to you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
对冒险者来说，这是体验异国文化的好机会...
不过，去不去随你。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
If you are tired of your daily
life, take a trip to a distant
country across the ocean.
Someplace like, oh I don't know, Amatsu~
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
厌倦了日复一日的生活，就去大洋彼岸的遥远国度旅行吧。
比如说，嗯...樱花城怎么样~

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
You came... Did you enjoy
your trip to Amatsu...?
Alright, I will take you
back to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
回来了...樱花城之旅还愉快吗...？
好，我送你回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Back to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Let's go then. You must have
so many things to talk about,
right? All aboard now.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
那就出发吧。你一定有不少旅行见闻想聊，对吧？
来，上船。

scripts.text:
[Walter Moers]
Well, take your time.
The ship to Alberta is
always ready to depart...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·默斯]
嗯，你慢慢来。
开往艾尔贝塔的船随时准备出发...

scripts.text:
[Yuuko]
I usually come to this well to
draw water, but never when it's
foggy or rainy. For some reason
whenever the weather is a
certain way, I feel like...
scripts.translation:
[优子]
我通常来这里打水，但大雾或下雨的时候就不会来。
不知道为什么，每当天气变成那样，我就觉得...

scripts.text:
[Yuuko]
...someone...or some thing is
struggling to crawl out from
the bottom of this well...
It really gives me the creeps.
scripts.translation:
[优子]
...好像有...有什么东西正拼命想从井底爬出来...
真的让人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[John]
Yo~
You're not from around here.
Heh, another outsider.
Just like me...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
哟~
你不是本地人吧。
嘿，又是一个外地人。
跟我一样...

scripts.text:
[John]
It's been five long years
since I've started doing
business here...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
我在这里做生意已经整整五年了...

scripts.text:
[John]
At first, I thought, 'What
a great chance!' when the
trade between the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom and Amatsu started.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
当初，卢恩·米德加兹王国和樱花城刚通商时，我心想：“好机会啊！”

scripts.text:
[John]
I wanted to do something great
and make the most of this
new opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
我想做点大事，好好利用这个新机会。

scripts.text:
[John]
And so, I decided to go to
Amatsu so I could learn to make
Amatsu cuisine. Then, I could
return to my hometown and make
this exotic food for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
于是，我决定到樱花城学做当地料理，再回家乡做给大家尝尝。

scripts.text:
[John]
But, I fell in love with Amatsu
and I ended up sticking around
here for the last five years.
During all that time, I've
been learning Amatsu cuisine,
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
可我渐渐爱上了樱花城，一留就是五年。
这些年，我一直学习当地料理...

scripts.text:
[John]
and cooking these dishes for
the towners, and enjoying myself
by talking to the locals,
transfixed in this very spot.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
做给镇民们吃，和当地人聊聊天，过得很开心，就这样一直留在这里。

scripts.text:
[John]
But recently, across the street,
the Sushi Master opened his shop.
...
Now, my only customers are flies.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
但最近，街对面那位寿司大师开了店。
...
现在，我的顾客只有苍蝇了。

scripts.text:
[John]
I was hoping to fulfill my
dream of becoming a renowned chef
in Amatsu, but...
I guess it's over...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
我曾梦想成为樱花城著名的厨师，但...
看来没戏了...

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Puhuhu~!
Did you see Miss Amatsu near
the Harbor? Isn't she
preeeetty?
scripts.translation:
[米米]
噗呼呼~！
你看见港口附近的樱花城小姐了吗？是不是特——别漂亮？

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
I'm going to enter the Miss
Amatsu Contest when I'm older.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
等我长大了，我要参加樱花城小姐选美比赛。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
I'm sure that I'm the prettiest
in this town but...
A lady can always use a little more makeup.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
我肯定是镇上最漂亮的女孩，不过...
女孩子总不嫌妆容再精致一点嘛。

scripts.text:
[Kosake]
*Hiccup*...My wife is just like,
...like a man...*Hiccup*...
I'm going to really...*Hiccup*...not go home this time...Hiccup
scripts.translation:
[小酒]
*打嗝*...我老婆简直就像个...像个男人...*打嗝*...
这次我要... *打嗝*...绝对不回家了...打嗝

scripts.text: Stop drinking and go home
scripts.translation: 别喝了，回家去

scripts.text: Let's drink together
scripts.translation: 一起喝一杯

scripts.text:
[Kosake]
What?! Do you want me to get
hit by my wife's big fist?
That's right! I said 'big fist!'
scripts.translation:
[小酒]
什么？！你想让我被老婆的大拳头揍吗？
没错！我说的是“大拳头”！

scripts.text:
[Kosake]
Sad to say, I married a woman
with man hands...
Big, strong hands that can kill a tiger.
scripts.translation:
[小酒]
说来伤心，我娶了个双手像男人一样的女人...
那双手又大又有力，打死老虎都没问题。

scripts.text:
[Druken Man]
It was in Ko...Koko-something
town. She hit me because I
lost some money...*Hiccup*
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
那是在科...科科什么的镇。因为我输了一些钱，她就揍了我...*打嗝*

scripts.text:
[Druken Man]
Life~~ is~~ nothing~~~
What is zeny~~~~ 
*Hiccup*...... *Hiccup*.......
.......................
........Z.z..z...zzz...

[Kosake]
Heh heh... nice lad...
But you know *Hiccup*
I can't give you any of mine! Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[小酒]
嘿嘿...好小子...
但是你知道的 *打嗝*
我不能把我的酒给你喝！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Kosake]
If you buy me a drink, I will think about it...Hehehe...*Hiccup*..
scripts.translation:
[小酒]
你请我喝一杯，我就考虑考虑...嘿嘿嘿...*嗝*...

scripts.text:
[Hatsue]
I'm worried about my husband.
He lost a lot of money in some distant town today.
scripts.translation:
[初枝]
我很担心我丈夫。
他今天在某个遥远的城镇输了很多钱。

scripts.text:
[Hatsue]
I got so mad at him, he ran off in
fear! I'm worried...what if he
went to the bar and starts drinking again? The man just doesn't have any backbone. *Phew*
scripts.translation:
[初枝]
我气得发火，他吓得跑了！
真担心...万一又跑去酒吧喝酒怎么办？这男人就没点骨气。*呼*

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
This place is special to me.
It's filled with memories of my wife.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
这个地方对我很特别。
这里充满了我对妻子的回忆。

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
It was under that big tree where
I first told her I loved her. At
the time, I really didn't know that she also had feelings for me.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
就是在那棵大树下，我第一次向她表白。当时，我真的不知道她对我也有同样的感情。

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
After that day, we had many
conversations here. Quiet
and peaceful, this was our
favorite place to be together.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
从那以后，我们常在这里聊天。
这里安静祥和，是我们最喜欢一起待着的地方。

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
When I close my eyes here, I
can picture our good times,
and it feels like it all happened yesterday.
...
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
在这里闭上眼睛，就能想起那些幸福的时光，仿佛一切就在昨天。
...

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
My wife passed away...
So now I only come here by
myself...But I feel like I'm with her whenever I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
我的妻子去世了...
所以现在只有我一个人来这里...但每次在这里，我都觉得她就在身边。

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
Do you have anyone that you
think about? If you have a
special someone, don't hesitate
or hold back. Be sure to treat
that person specially.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
你有没有牵挂的人？
如果有心爱的人，别犹豫，也别压抑感情，一定要好好珍惜。

scripts.text:
[Jyaburo]
Human beings live such short
lives. But we're able to laugh
throughout life and forget the
sadness.
...Always be happy.
scripts.translation:
[贾布罗]
人生如此短暂，可我们仍能在欢笑中忘却悲伤。
...愿你一直快乐。

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
It is a pleasure to meet you.
My name is Hutari Shioko.
My hobby is listening to music.
I'm an avid fan of classical music.
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
很高兴认识你，我叫二人 志保子。
我喜欢听音乐，尤其热爱古典音乐。

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
There is an old story about
the hill in our town.
Have you heard this story before?
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
关于我们镇上的那座山，有一个古老的故事。
你以前听过这个故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
It is said that if you propose
under that tree, you and your
lover will live a happy life for all eternity.
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
传说如果你在那棵树下求婚，你和你的爱人将永远幸福地生活在一起。

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
However, the proposal can not be
done at any given time. The legend states that it can only be done on Saturday evenings.
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
不过，并不是随时求婚都可以。
传说，只有周六晚上才行。

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
After the proposal, the reply must
be answered before Sunday evening. This is the most crucial part of it.
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
求婚之后，必须在周日晚上之前得到答复。这是最关键的部分。

scripts.text:
[Hutari Shioko]
If you like someone...
You should try proposing
under that tree. I'm sure 
happy things will happen, if you do.
scripts.translation:
[二人 志保子]
有喜欢的人，就试着在那棵树下求婚吧。
我相信，一定会有好事发生。

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
This is a beautiful place
with everlasting cherry blossoms.
Also, this town is the origin of
legendary play, 'White Dryad.'
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
这里很美，樱花常开不败。
传世名剧《白森林妖姬》也发源于这座小镇。

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
If you know a girl who is
talented in acting, please
bring her to me. I have been
searching for a girl who could
play the role as the 'White Dryad.'
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
认识有表演天赋的女孩，就请带她来见我。
我一直在寻找能演好“白森林妖姬”的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
The 'White Dryad' is a nymph of
cherry tree... It has been hard to
find a girl who can perform
as the 'White Dryad...'
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
“白森林妖姬”是樱花树的精灵...
可惜，一直找不到能演好她的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
Are you interested in acting?
I need someone who sees
the passion in acting and
can understand my vision.
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
你对表演感兴趣吗？
我需要真正热爱表演、又能理解我创作理念的人。

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
When you stand on the stage,
you need to become the
character. Your acting needs
to touch the hearts of the
audience and touch their souls.
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
站上舞台，就要化身为角色。
你的表演要打动观众的心，触动他们的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Garakame sensei]
Everyone's life is like a 
drama, right? Enjoy your life
as what you are and find me
someday when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[加拉卡梅老师]
人生不也像一出戏吗？
尽情过好自己的生活吧，等准备好了，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Bonubonu]
That tree on the hill is
a very old tree. It is a big
cherry tree with everlasting blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[博努博努]
山上那棵树很古老，是棵巨大的樱花树，花朵常开不败。

scripts.text:
[Bonubonu]
There is something about this
tree that makes me forget about
all the troubles in my life when I sit under it.
scripts.translation:
[博努博努]
这棵树有一种魔力，让我坐在树下时
忘记生活中所有的烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Bonubonu]
Everything about this tree is
simply wonderful...
I can't really describe how
I feel when I look at it...
It just leaves me breathless...
scripts.translation:
[博努博努]
这棵树的一切都太美妙了...
我甚至无法描述看到它时的感受...
它让我屏住呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Bonubonu]
You should visit the tree and
spend some time there.
It is really a miraculous and gracious tree...
scripts.translation:
[博努博努]
你也该去树下坐坐。
那真是棵神奇又美好的树...

scripts.text:
[Sakura Seiichi]
Ah... I'm not a weirdo so
don't panic. I'm just an ordinary
veterinarian. My job is curing
sick animals.
scripts.translation:
[樱 诚一]
啊...我不是怪人，别紧张。
我只是个普通兽医，替生病的动物治病。

scripts.text:
[Sakura Seiichi]
By the way... Do you know?
The story about the cherry tree
on the hill...I guess you haven't heard about it...
scripts.translation:
[樱 诚一]
对了...山上那棵樱花树的故事，你听说过吗？
大概还没有吧...

scripts.text:
[Sakura Seiichi]
That tree has a secret of
keeping its beauty and whiteness.
The secret is...
There are corpses buried under...
that tree...
scripts.translation:
[樱 诚一]
那棵树有一个保持美丽和洁白的秘密。
秘密是...
树下埋着尸体...

scripts.text: How horrible!
scripts.translation: 太可怕了！

scripts.text: You have got to be kidding.
scripts.translation: 你一定在开玩笑

scripts.text:
[Sakura Seiichi]
Kuhuhu... They could be...
By the way, do you want
make a bet on it...?
scripts.translation:
[樱 诚一]
嘿嘿...也许有呢...
怎么样，要不要打个赌...？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHis voice was getting lower
and lower as the wind blew.
Finally, I couldn't even hear his voice. I can't even recall what he was trying to tell me...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF风吹过，他的声音越来越低，最后完全听不清了。
我甚至记不起他想说些什么...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sakura Seiichi]
I can't help it if you think that way. But one day, you too could be buried underneath...
scripts.translation:
[樱 诚一]
如果你这么想，我也没办法。但总有一天，你也会像它们一样被埋入地下...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHis laugh was getting lower
and lower as the wind blew.
Finally, I couldn't even hear anything. I can't even recall what he was trying to tell me...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF风吹过，他的笑声越来越低，最后什么也听不见了。
我甚至记不起他想说些什么...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs she mentioned, this tree
seems to be a famous place
for proposing lovers.
There were several carved symbols
of hearts and initials of lovers
on the bark.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF正如她所说，这棵树似乎是情侣求婚的著名地点。
树皮上刻着好些爱心，以及情侣姓名的首字母。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBesides proposals, people
gather under this tree when
they discuss important
matters. I could listen to
all kinds of stories
in this magnificent place.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF除了求婚，人们也会在树下商谈重要的事。
在这个壮观的地方，可以听到各种各样的故事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe legendary play, 'White Dryad'.....
I never heard about that title but
it sounds familiar.
Nymph of cherry tree... What would
be her position in the play?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF传世名剧《白森林妖姬》...
没听过这个名字，却莫名觉得熟悉。
樱花树的精灵...她在剧中是什么样的角色呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI would like to find
a person who is talented
in acting and help her until
she performs the play. However,
it seems to be easier said than done.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF真想找到一位有表演天赋的女孩，帮她登台演出这部戏。
不过，说起来容易，做起来难。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI might have talent in
acting which hasn't been discovered yet. I thought, 'If I dress up, I should perform as the 'White Dryad...'^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也许我也有尚未被发现的表演天赋。
“打扮一下，说不定我也能演白森林妖姬...”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnlike other cherry trees,
this tree has a strong fragrance.
I just fell into a relaxed
mood. The fragrance eased
my burdens and I felt
very comfortable.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这棵樱花树的香气比其他的浓郁得多。
闻着花香，心头的重担仿佛卸了下来，让人放松而舒适。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt was just for a few moments
but I could forget the
burdens of life. I wish to
come back again and
sit under this tree...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF虽只是短短片刻，却能忘却生活的重担。
真想再回来，坐在这棵树下...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis strong fragrance
is making me dizzy. Not like
other cherry trees, this tree's
shimmering white petals
felt strange.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF浓郁的花香让人头晕。
不同于其他樱花树，这棵树泛着微光的洁白花瓣透着一丝诡异。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt feels as if my soul is
being drained if I stay here
longer. After a glimpse of
the cherry tree, I thought to
myself, 'I must get out of here quickly.'^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF再待下去，灵魂仿佛就要被抽走了。
瞥了樱花树一眼，我心想：“得赶紧离开这里。”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere was a cherry tree
on the hill. It doesn't look
like the other trees.
This tree seems to have
a long history...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF山上有棵樱花树，看起来与别的树不同。
它似乎已经生长了许多年...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAre there any people
who live here? I took
a look around and found
someone down the hill.
I better ask her about this tree.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有人住吗？环顾四周，发现山下有个人。
去问问她这棵树的事吧。^000000
